rows: - Removing `GITHUB_TOKEN` and `CI_RUNNER_GITHUB_READ_TOKEN` from `backend/service-kit/data/registry.json` (kept equal to `clis/secrets/src/data/registry.json` by a flow test) changes a file every Rust service builds from, so the deploy-legs flow test saw every leg change and the gate failed (with an offload worker test and the Nx cache contract test, which ran while the disk had 0 MB free). The registry edits were reverted; the compose and group changes stay. The two keys are cleaned out of both registries in one push that is allowed to redeploy every service, together with the next change to `service-kit`, not alone.
